lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno said, I'm in hot water,
And hopped in a bath, warm and hotter!
Kiki said, that's not the deal,
It means you're in trouble, for real!
[chorus]
In hot water, in hot water,
Uh oh, trouble, it's getting hotter!
In hot water, in hot water,
Say you're sorry, then it's not a bother!
[verse]
It means you're in a lot of trouble,
You broke the rules and made a muddle,
Say you're sorry, make it right,
And soon the trouble's out of sight!
[chorus]
In hot water, in hot water,
Uh oh, trouble, it's getting hotter!
In hot water, in hot water,
Fix your mess and you'll feel better!
[outro]
So when you've made a mess, oh dear,
You're in hot water, that's clear!
